bars.says: On the Slime, a builder can distinguish firm building shelves from yielding ground and liquid channels, and finds local stone through production rather than quarrying.

meant.intent: Ordinary terrain must look and act like the body, with readable building/travel choices; no natural bedrock.

figurative.stands_for: soft-looking body surfaces that constrain movement/building differently from crust; no elastic-physics simulation
figurative.accept: A soft mat stays visually still while its edge, movement and building affordance distinguish it from the crust.

accept: A wall can stand on a crust shelf while the liquid channel makes the builder choose a different site.
A heavy building can be placed on the firm shelf but is refused on the soft mat; the compressor supplies blocks that a worker uses for construction instead of quarrying local rock.
reject: A green soil recolour offers identical building ground everywhere.
A convenient natural quarry substitutes for producing the local building stone.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires visual differentiation coupled to actual building choices and productive stone, so recolour-only builds fail.

bars.says: A colonist can harvest the body into cooked food and usable building blocks, while eating it raw relieves poison and also exposes susceptible flesh to absorption.

meant.intent: The benefit and fee are the same material chain; processing supports repeatable colony work, not a helper-fed demonstration or mandatory raw feeding forever.

figurative.accept: A worker harvests a bellows sac and processes its raw slime while the underlying terrain and nearby animals remain intact.

accept: Normal harvest, hauling and bills provide a meal a colonist eats and blocks a worker builds with; the raw poisoned eater loses poison while gaining film.
A prepared worker on constructed flooring can continue production without renewed contact; raw consumption still carries its own fee.
reject: Finished meals and blocks are spawned for the scene, while the normal benches cannot complete their bills.
Raw slime cures susceptible eaters without charging film, or cooked meals secretly retain the raw-dose effect.
bars.lazy: none: Completed harvest, bills, eating and construction plus raw poison relief coupled to susceptible absorption exclude recipes-only and free-cure builds; repeat doses respect the declared ceiling rather than lowering film.

bars.says: After body contact, a player can identify worsening, impairing film on susceptible colonists and animals before dissolution, without conversion making them hostile, and any resulting loss shows its cause and leaves belongings recoverable.

meant.intent: The ordinary lethal ladder applies to colonists and animals, with warnings before loss and accounting after it; disappearance is never the sign by itself.

figurative.accept: Separate wet areas on the local map share contact behaviour without a rendered creature connecting them.

accept: Health labels, impairments and a named warning identify a worsening worker; without rescue the death cause remains readable and their carried things can be recovered.
A native keeps feeding without acquiring film while a susceptible outsider deteriorates; absorption itself creates no faction change or attack order.
A roofed workshop on constructed flooring prevents new contact exposure; a roof over bare crust still lets a susceptible worker acquire film.
reject: A terminal severity flag is logged while the pawn and equipment silently disappear.
Only visitors can dissolve, or crossing a film stage creates a hostile faction or manhunter job.
Only a death notice identifies absorption; before that the player cannot identify the threatened patient or the worsening film.
bars.lazy: none: Actual contact, identifiable worsening impairment before loss, non-hostility, cause-of-loss evidence and recoverable belongings are all explicit; neither a silent severity counter nor an after-death-only warning meets the words.

bars.says: A player can reverse early film by leaving body ground, reverse established film in drying country, or have a capable helper complete toxic antidote treatment before dissolution.

meant.intent: Geography and an ordinary targeted treatment job are genuine escapes; ordinary neutral country is not an instant advanced-film cure and a treatment order is not completion.

figurative.stands_for: contact-active native slime ground, including hardened crust; leaving it means reaching a non-slime contact surface, not leaving a giant pawn
figurative.accept: An early-film patient improves on a constructed floor in the same Slime map without crossing a biome boundary.

figurative.stands_for: biomes carrying DryingBiomeExtension, reached on a local map or by supported caravan travel; never hardened slime crust or an arid-looking untagged tile
figurative.accept: A patient improves on a tagged salt-biome map even though it is not visibly dry desert; hardened slime crust does not reverse established film.

accept: An early exposed worker improves on a constructed floor; an advanced patient stays impaired there but improves on a road in a tagged drying biome or after completed toxic treatment.
A downed patient can be treated by a prepared helper; a delayed untreated patient still reaches the lethal outcome.
reject: Entering any non-slime tile instantly clears advanced film and makes the drying route irrelevant.
The cure function works in isolation while a normal helper cannot target, reach and finish treating the patient.
Hardened slime crust or an untagged arid-looking tile reverses established film merely because it looks dry.
bars.lazy: none: The says requires each distinct route and a helper finishing treatment before death, so neither a universal step-off cure nor a helper-only effect can satisfy it.

bars.says: After cultivated native ground reverts to slime, a settler sees a food crop fail to reach harvest there while the same crop reaches harvest on imported substrate or in hydroponics and unzoned native forage regrows.

meant.intent: Field failure is an observed crop outcome attributable to reverted substrate, not a slight yield reduction, a renamed terrain or a prediction about indefinite farming; native forage and prepared workshops remain.
meant.source: Frozen the_slime.md §5 farms-fail law and §6 no permanent farmland; delegated: use a failed post-reversion sow-to-harvest attempt compared with a successful same-crop managed-substrate control within the declared observation stretch. Invalid sowing on reverted substrate is also a readable failure of that attempt. An earlier crop may finish before conversion; hydroponics and imported substrate remain managed alternatives.

figurative.stands_for: native slime substrate, not imported hydroponic equipment or constructed flooring
figurative.accept: A roofed hydroponic crop remains productive while an adjacent open body-ground field fails.

accept: The field visibly reverts; a subsequent food-crop attempt cannot be sown there or stops growing before harvest because of that substrate, while the matched crop reaches harvest on imported substrate or in compatible hydroponics and unzoned native forage regrows.
A constructed workshop floor stays a workshop while nearby native growth completes its shared wet-growth cycle.
reject: The field becomes rich slime but its food crop still reaches harvest, merely later or with a smaller yield.
Neither crop reaches harvest because the workers never sow or both plots lack light or heat; this is called converted-field failure.
Conversion attacks unzoned native forage or replaces the colony floor to create the promised failure.
bars.lazy: none: A failed post-reversion crop attempt beside a successful same-crop managed control and regrowing forage excludes label-only conversion, slower productive farming and general neglect.

Growing-zone cells sown/unsown/designated-but-not-yet-sown/harvested/de-zoned; primary grass/rich/hardened and packaged legacy growing ground; crop fertility tolerance across loaded ordinary food crops; field areas 1..2500 cells, map areas 22500..160000; over 15,60,100 days; all ExplosiveGrowth wet/cycle mechanics active. For each loaded ordinary food crop, pair a post-reversion sow-to-harvest attempt with compatible imported substrate or hydroponics under the same season/light/temperature, sowing effort and care. Attempt early enough in each declared stretch for the successful control to reach harvest; otherwise extend and record the stretch, never call an unfinished comparison a pass. Include a crop already growing at conversion separately from a new attempt.
range.left_out: No promised crop yield, conversion deadline or fixed failure percentage. Constructed floors, off-body agriculture and hydroponics are outside the open body-soil law. A deliberate replacement of substrate is management, not permanent native farmland. A pre-conversion crop may finish. Exotic crops deliberately able to grow without suitable substrate are outside ordinary food crops; no promise to suppress arbitrary third-party crop mechanics.

bars.says: A player living on the Slime meets resistant grazers and corrosive scavengers, a hunting fubbum and a flying dwommo, with native animals able to drink their environmental water and outsiders readably being absorbed (health and inspect).

meant.intent: Ordinary native roles and outsider contrast must function, not just be listed; no roster eviction or new ecological minigame. Oomb refuse feeding and wuum reproductive renewal count as life, but channel paving and oomb multiplication are deferred.

accept: Native grazers feed, an oomb eats refuse, and a thirsty native beside local liquid drinks without accumulating dehydration; a susceptible outsider carries film shown in health and inspect with real impairment while its sprite remains unchanged.
A fubbum selects permitted prey through normal hunting and a dwommo enters flight according to its tracker while keeping its native resistance.
A dying corrosive native causes visible acid injury in its affected area, while a matched animal beyond that area escapes that death burst.
reject: An animal lineup supplies all labels while every creature starves, the floater only walks, or natives dehydrate beside their own water.
Visitor arrivals drown out native encounters or film itself starts new aggression.
bars.lazy: none: Actual feeding/scavenging, corrosive handling danger, drinking, hunting, flight and outsider absorption are required; lineup-only, stat-only and no-water builds fail.

bars.says: The resident titanoslime naturally engulfs prey, exposes time to rescue it, returns belongings when digestion kills, and permanently grows as it feeds under default settings.

meant.intent: This is the ordinary apex animal, a mobile part of the same consuming body. Rescue/release and truthful occupied geometry make its lethal lifecycle usable; chunk manufacture and wound spawning are not needed.
meant.source: Owner Titanoslime request and permanent-growth ruling recorded in RM_titanoslime_spec.md §11 and TITANOSLIME_SLIME_BIOME_1; standing readable-loss ruling; delegated: keep natural melee, struggle/release and size-engine integration as necessary life.

accept: A normal melee encounter puts eligible prey inside the giant with a named countdown; downing the captor returns that same prey, and a completed meal leaves gear while the fed giant grows and keeps its growth.
A rescued victim reappears with injuries and film from the encounter; the colony can select and route around the grown animal after a reload.
reject: Only a debug engulf function can swallow prey, or a countdown exists but downing the giant destroys its prisoner.
The sprite enlarges while occupied cells and prey capacity remain wrong, or starving silently shrinks a default grown giant.
bars.lazy: none: The says combines natural action, rescue time, terminal belongings and permanent feeding growth; debug-only and sprite-only giants fail.

bars.says: During organism-induced slime rain, the player can drink and collect potable floodwater on exposed natural slime ground as it briefly floods and drains without flooding constructed floors or roofed rooms.

meant.intent: The organism waters itself; useful water and receding inundation are ordinary land/weather already ruled in. Shallow standing potable surface water covers every unroofed, unbuilt natural slime land cell, including crust, grass and cultivated cells; existing liquid channels, constructed floors, edifices and roofed cells receive no ambient flood layer. It is FlowWorks-accounted water over the substrate, not a terrain swap or a tint. Normal in-place drinking and collection satisfy thirst without a raw ingestion dose. Ground stays traversable with its underlying movement costs and shared wet/slip behaviour; flooded bare slime still causes contact film. The layer neither destroys crops nor changes fertility, floors or building support: field failure remains conversion. Recession removes only event surface water, leaving prior terrain unchanged except independent conversion/growth writes, and retains collected water.
meant.source: Frozen the_slime.md §§3,4b,5-6 organism-induced rain/potable flood carve-out; RM_gelatinous_slime_mod.md §2. delegated: rainfall/collection/drain ownership belongs to FlowWorks, no parallel liquid engine. Designer selection: the frozen sheet does not choose cells, layer, movement or crop effects; the explicit flood picture in definition.md settles these without claiming the provider already exists.

figurative.stands_for: temporarily stands under shallow, drinkable surface water on the declared exposed natural slime land; not a deep river, a tint or a permanent terrain change
figurative.accept: A worker walks across a flooded crust shelf and drinks there while a floored workshop and a roofed bare-ground room stay unflooded; the shelf retains its building support.
figurative.reject: A green wet tint has no standing water account or in-place drinking action, or a deep-water terrain swap cuts the route and changes the shelf.

accept: An open collector gains potable water during the organism event; a worker also drinks standing water on exposed natural slime land, satisfying thirst without a raw ingestion dose, and the surface water recedes afterward.

Constructed floors and roofed rooms remain unflooded while exposed grass and a planted field hold shallow water; movement and building support remain, bare slime still causes contact film, and recession leaves the underlying terrain and collected water intact.
reject: The weather turns green and paints wet ground, but there is no standing potable water account or normal in-place drink and collection action.
A permanent expanding pool is called drainage, raw channel slime substitutes for potable rainwater, or floodwater hides contact-active slime and makes bare ground safe.
Flooding reaches constructed floors or roofed rooms, kills the crops instead of conversion doing so, or replaces terrain and leaves the shelf unusable after recession.
bars.lazy: none: Standing potable water, normal drinking and collection, bounded cell eligibility and real recession exclude tint-only, channel-only and destructive terrain-swap builds.

range.varies: Authored local maps 150x150 through 400x400 (include 250x250 and 325x325), terrain interiors/edges and roads/floors/roof combinations; first day and after 100 days; 1, 6 and 40 colonists with 0, 1 and several active patients; before/after mid-state save/reload and swapped action order. Numbers delimit observation cases, not approval thresholds. Authored tile rainfall 0 and nonzero; normal natural event selection as well as controlled event replay; event onset/sustained/end, roofed/open collectors, empty/partial/full tanks, dug channels/beds/undug natural ground, drainage blocked/open, existing liquids and floors/doors; during and after save/reload; rain before/after harvest and field conversion. Flood-cell classes: unroofed natural hardened/rich/grass/mud and owned legacy equivalents, planted/unplanted ground, constructed flooring, roofed bare ground, roofed rooms, edifices, existing liquid channels and imported substrate; roof/floor added or removed mid-event and independent conversion/growth during recession.
range.left_out: No imported river, planetary rain editing, exact rainfall frequency/volume/depth or bespoke flood catastrophe. A sealed player-made basin may store water; it cannot be used to claim ambient inundation never drains. Raw channel slime is a separate last-resort liquid. No elevation solver, channel-widening flood or lateral flood entry onto excluded cells. Flood depth, pulse rate and duration are checks; no new crop-drowning mechanic.

bars.says: Across a season on a full Slime map, the colony can keep working among renewing native life while managing absorption, failed fields, the feeding giant and receding slime rain, and can resume that routine after reload and a changed order of work.

meant.intent: The complete shipped system remains usable as one place. Prepared management coexists with genuine threats; no flood of slime/water/animals, desert of forage/native encounters, stalled work loop or storm of errors may stand in for a season.
meant.source: Current brief: exactly one whole bar, full map/season/all kept mechanics/defaults/nothing locked/mid-save reload/second action order. delegated: inferred seasonal coexistence from the_slime.md land/life and ordinary contact/material bargain, not a measured enjoyment claim.

figurative.stands_for: forage regrowth and continuing native ecological encounters, not immortality or replacement of every dead individual
figurative.accept: An old animal dies with an accounted cause while younger natives and regrowing forage keep the landscape inhabited.

accept: A prepared colony gathers, renders, presses, builds and treats patients as native plants and animals continue their roles; post-reversion crop attempts fail beside productive managed-substrate crops and water recedes without swallowing the workplace.
After reloading during rain with an active patient and a held victim, the player finishes the same ordinary actions, then repeats them with harvesting and treatment in a different order.
reject: The season works only with clear weather, plant tops, reproduction, predation or contact secretly disabled.
Shared growth coats the work area in permanent slime, rain accumulates without recession, native life disappears, or jobs and alerts cease to progress after reload.
bars.lazy: none: The says requires the simultaneous season, renewing life, work, risk management, reload and changed order, so isolated pads cannot pass.

range.varies: Authored local maps 150x150 through 400x400 (include 250x250 and 325x325), terrain interiors/edges and roads/floors/roof combinations; first day and after 100 days; 1, 6 and 40 colonists with 0, 1 and several active patients; before/after mid-state save/reload and swapped action order. Numbers delimit observation cases, not approval thresholds. Full 250x250 and 325x325 authored maps, plus 150x150/400x400 boundary runs; 15 in-game days as a season, continued 60/100-day projections for slow starvation/feedback. Colonies 6 and 40; native/visitor populations at low/ordinary/saturated starts, edible harvest/dry/soaked state mixes and poor/fair native patches. Save mid-way during a compound rain/patient/held-victim state, reload, repeat core production/contact/cure, and reverse harvest/treatment/build order. If no natural cycle appears, extend rather than force it and call it seasonal evidence.
range.left_out: No new planets, arbitrary other biomes or prolonged deliberate starvation of an unprepared colony. No fixed sustainable colony size, perfect safety, performance budget or required stochastic rare spawn. Weather/AI/timers may run faster in wall time only through normal tick advancement; no skipped jobs, food needs, thermal/flight/water/growth pulses or rescaled random probabilities.

checks.what: Loaded primary/legacy terrain identities, tags, fertility, crop requirements, path costs, affordances, hasBedrock, allowRoads, animalDensity and weather-pool entries. Numbers are regression data, not acceptance.
Production RM_SlimeLadder threshold/rate/dose/poison/antidote fuzz and RM_TitanKernel gates/growth/registration invariants; keep source default numeric snapshots separately.

ConversionAttempts distribution and growing-zone source gate; loaded crop viability after replacement, including rich slime currently fertility 0.85. Source numbers inform M2, not bars. Record each paired crop attempt, substrate-caused sow/growth refusal and successful managed-control harvest; a timeout alone is not evidence of failure.
Settings schema/default/reset/consumer coverage, including existing-pawn caches, active state, acquisition gates and all-off behaviour; no ghost next-version jobs, products, letters or incidents.

Snapshot observer sensitivity: planted wrong identity, missing read, destroyed carried item, cancelled job, wrong loaded assembly, missing log interval and failed recovery must not print success. Supersedes scene_observer instrument leaf.

Kit paths/facings, Dwommo numbered-animation prefix resolution and whole-body flight fields. Asset counts/extra styles never passing requirements. Owner Titanoslime stage-one/five visual obligation remains owed.
Normal bill/input/output/item ledger, poison effect before resistance, safe cooked meal without raw-dose callback, recipe costs/research and actual construction availability.
Pawn/holder/gear/terrain/water/settings identity equality across recovery and save/reload. Colony floor checks clean log and load; a red check alone is not a refusal.

Visitor cap counts all factionless wild animals; cap boundary, empty-neighbour, no-on-load seed; Wuum cap/clone settings and oomb advancement/fission disabled while feeding remains; natural flight tracker state.

Weather natural eligibility on authored zero-rainfall tile, no campaign Rain/FoggyRain, liquid conservation and potable collector contents; isolated forecast versus actual event receipt. Next-version constraints retained: gene target/rider/marks/coma/rescue, expensive exclusive last-touch return/no marriage rewind, finite chunk/ally danger and real seal accounting. No default acceptance scene depends on them.

Clinical state walk compares exact game transition witnesses including caravan loss/gear, invalid location, old saves, settings OFF advanced film, terminal-on-toggle and near-boundary antidote order. A model passing its own mirror is insufficient.

rules.rule: Designer rule (attackable): Contact uses current top-terrain RM_SlimeTerrain tag, including hardened shelves; roof alone is not protection, constructed non-slime floor is. Rainwater is not a film dose. No slower hardened exposure is promised by its poetic description. All packaged legacy body ground needs explicit semantic mapping.

Designer rule (attackable): Ordinary early film decays off body, advanced film holds in neutral country, drying tag takes priority, antidote clears subterminal film at toxic cost. Turned-off hazard stops application/dosing/progression and clears existing film safely; source advanced hold while OFF is a delivery defect. Other coma/genes are not cleared.

Designer rule (attackable): Poison scope follows auditable toxin/venom/radiation classification with injury/missing-part/addiction exclusions. Raw benefit runs before resistance; resistant eaters legitimately pay no film. No universal cure of arbitrary bad health. Preserve ordinary dose/cure primitives even with all gene extras disabled.

Designer rule (attackable): Growing-zone designation triggers substrate conversion, including not-yet-sown zones; de-zoning stops new zone-driven changes but never restores ground. After reversion, an ordinary food-crop sow-to-harvest attempt fails through substrate incompatibility while the same crop succeeds on managed imported substrate or hydroponics. Mere slow growth or lower yield is insufficient. Preserve native forage, floors and shared growth; keep zone and plant-top writes separate in the ledger.

Designer rule (attackable): Use ExplosiveGrowth ordinary and wet cycles/Slime tops as shipped dependency, all ON. Its rich-slime rings already protect water, floors and edifices. Do not redesign engine; calibrate wetting/top/produce feedback and attack local tuning/roster/terrain choices before changing a bar.

Designer rule (attackable): FlowWorks owns liquid quantities/composition, collection/drainage/slip and native thirst. Slime-rain precipitation must be naturally eligible at authored zero rainfall without changing planetary rainfall; ordinary Rain/FoggyRain absent in campaign. Collected rainwater is potable; raw channel slime keeps last-resort purge/film. Existing stored rainwater survives a rain toggle. Ambient inundation uses the definition.md shallow surface-water mask, never a terrain swap: exposed natural slime land only; roofs/floors/edifices/channels excluded. It is directly drinkable and collectible, retains underlying contact and support, and leaves crops intact. New roofs/floors stop further input; existing event water there drains without wetting neighbours. Recession does not roll back independent conversion/growth or erase storage.

Designer rule (attackable): Keep every current roster species. Visitor cap currently counts ALL factionless wild animals, not just arrivals; do not rewrite it as visitor-only without attack/testing. No load-time visitor seed; no hostility created by film. Native predation and acid death bursts retain normal causes; oomb fission/promotion and titan shedding OFF by default.

Designer rule (attackable): Engulf is a normal melee tool with source flesh/size/capacity/holder guards and existing digestion/struggle/release. Growth is permanent by default; preserve half-body prey rule, max-stage cap and shared occupied-cell registration. Default shedding OFF never decrements growth or removes gelatids from the roster.

Designer rule (attackable): Existing health/alerts/inspect strings and necessary loss messages expose cause, patient and available action; save warning latches. Ordinary animal losses need inspect/death/combat evidence rather than colonist letter spam. No new triage screen, optional registry messages or sentient speech. Remove misleading universal peace, faster crust, woodless-world and no-progress wording.

Designer rule (attackable): Real per-major-feature switches, searchable/reset/scoped defaults; add missing core rain/production/native-special switches. Next-version labels default OFF, consumers and acquisition gated, no hidden work after disable. Mid-state: release held prey, retain grown giant, stop conversion, preserve paid-vat/active-sample/temporary-terrain state without progressing disabled extras or destroying people/items. Reset means proposed defaults, never historical all-ON.

Designer rule (attackable): Use accounted imported vanilla steel/wood or existing salvage to build benches and floors, normal costs/research and working bills; no local rock. No thumbstalk wood promise: its current harvest is empty under the later wood ruling. Imported/off-body crops and hydroponics do not waive failure of permanent open body-ground farms.

Designer rule (attackable): All DLC are assumed. RM native names remain RM; campaign genes/Helix/vault stay campaign-side. Composed package is mandrake.rm.biomes. No worldgen, repaint, CSV editing or new planet option in any version. Zero world tiles is expected. Direct Sun and shade use the shared geometric rule; no local heat exception. Owner build hold remains; this is a proposal only.

meetings.why: Farm conversion and wet Slime plant tops write rich terrain while rain changes wetness and exposure reads the top layer. Floors are protected by growth but legacy overlays/flow ownership and productive rich ground make a loop. Unknown until map-region simulation calibrated to actual terrain writes. The proposed water layer cannot replace substrate or shield contact; post-reversion crop failure must coexist with native regrowth even under rain and plant-top writes. These explicit choices still need game-calibrated region coverage.

A fertile-looking field fails while harvest supplies meals, antidote and compression; growth tops can multiply output and build floors that prevent exposure. Pairwise useful production and failed farming do not establish a functioning whole-colony labour/raw budget.

Existing UI is the required display, not a second simulation. Patient/captor/weather/terrain identities and causes are shared observations. Warning payloads describe current rate/location and never imply a universal pause or peaceful ecology. Ground silhouettes and real actions satisfy distinct readings; no new UI or sentience is necessary.

Each saved identity has one owner: health comp clock/latch, giant ThingOwner/mass, map terrain/zone, shared growth/water engines, settings. Tests resume the same ids and state owners; restored branch copies avoid lossy cleanup. Runtime correctness is still read by the bar instruments. Physics/geography uncertainties are assigned above, not asserted solved here.

Raw poison relief, resistance, contact, early/advanced persistence, drying, toxic cure, engulf release, caravan travel and feature disable share a lethal boundary. Source OFF can leave advanced film holding; terminal-in-caravan belongings/signs are unproven. An enumerated transition walk must include real action calibration before acceptance.
meetings.model: M1: Situation and clinical transition generator

meetings.why: Visitor cap counts native wild animals too; Wuum cloning, normal recruitment, predation, acid-chain deaths, giant feeding and shared forage renewal can starve arrivals or consume life. Deferred shedding/fission remove loops but do not prove coexistence.

Potable rain collection and recession, shared wet-growth/Slime top, farmland loss, native thirst and raw channel-liquid effects share liquid and terrain ownership. Existing ApplyRain is not evidence of undug slime inundation or potable collector delivery. Test the declared exposed-land flood mask and direct drinking, exclusion of floors/roofs/channels, continued underlying contact and crop survival during water alone; conversion must cause the paired crop failure. No claim of delivered undug-ground water follows from this specification.
meetings.model: M3: Rain and liquid ownership sweep

meetings.why: Growing body footprints, finite release locations, held-victim film/death, settings-off and corpse-site conversion meet on edge/blocked cells. A valid prey gate does not prove a legal non-destructive release at every legal placement.

Each deferred acquisition and active consumer is behind a labelled OFF gate, with its own ticket and truth table. Exposure/engulf no longer require archive entries; oomb feeding no longer requires promotion/fission; core material/cure primitives stay independent of gene content. No default bar needs a seeker, chunk, vat, seal, ritual, solvent dish or ruin. This is an explicit decoupling requirement, not a claim current code already meets it.
